summary: Over-generate 12 candidates, pick top-7 in Swift
hypothesis: Generating more than 7 candidates and then selecting the best 7 via a deterministic Swift scorer should improve quality, because a larger candidate pool increases the chance of covering more question dimensions before the final cut.
technique: A single on-device FM call over-produces 12 candidate questions, then a deterministic Swift ranker scores and selects the top 7 for output — no additional model calls involved in selection.
label: exp002
